apps.name: Bident
apps.tagline: A live 3D intelligence console for planet Earth.
apps.description: Photorealistic 3D globe with live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic and public cameras, plus hands-free voice control. Works without API keys; optional keys are added inside the app.

apps.name: E2E Testing OS
apps.tagline: Agentic end-to-end testing for web and mobile apps.
apps.description: Describe a goal in plain language and an agent drives your app to reach it, then checks the result with locators and assertions. Builds the e2e CLI and runs it against any project folder: set up tests, run them, or let an agent explore your app.
